## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Energy and Financials are clearly ABOVE TREND while Technology shows mixed RECOVERY/CORRECTION patterns and large semiconductor divergences; leadership concentrated across Tech/Energy/Financials.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +9.78% | 1M: +7.13%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +10.58%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: SCHW (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare also resilient: JNJ (1W: +3.71% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AMAT (1W: -21.09% | 1M: +25.94%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -21.05% | 1M: +11.16%) CORRECTION, ASML (1W: -11.10% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION. Industrials weak: CAT (1W: -10.97% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION, ETN (1W: -6.23% | 1M: +0.91%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +0.78%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +13.33% | 1M: -2.44%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +10.34% | 1M: -5.43%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +10.25% | 1M: -23.04%) RECOVERY, SCHW (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5 — Tech/Energy/Financials).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -6.23% | 1M: +0.91%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +0.78%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -9.26%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.93% | 1M: +10.94%) CORRECTION, CAT (1W: -10.97% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION — weakness clustered in Materials/Industrials and selective Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +13.33% | 1M: -2.44%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +10.34% | 1M: -5.43%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +10.25% | 1M: -23.04%) RECOVERY, SCHW (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence in semiconductors — multiple large-cap names show 1W ≠ 1M (INTC, AMAT, LRCX) indicating a MAJOR DIVERGENCE; treat as tactical, not core signals.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with short-term bounces and sharp pullbacks; AAPL (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND sits as an outlier while NVDA (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY and MSFT (1W: +2.77% | 1M: -8.00%) RECOVERY show short-term strength against a weakening semiconductor group; Sector tone: internal rotation with selective leadership risk.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: SCHW (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +7.40%) ABOVE TREND — Financial breadth supportive and confirming part of the market’s stabilization.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive bid present and broad: JNJ (1W: +3.71% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +7.46%) ABOVE TREND — sector is providing stability amid tech rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Energy exposure (SCHW, PSX, MPC) and reduce exposure to high-beta semiconductors showing CORRECTION (AMAT, INTC, LRCX); monitor selective Tech RECOVERY names (AAPL, NVDA, MSFT) for confirmation. Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth given sector breadth and leadership mix.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -21.05% | 1M: +11.16%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -21.09% | 1M: +25.94%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: -23.12% | 1M: +9.93%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.51%) and Financials (1W: +2.55%) — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.48%) and Industrials (1W: -1.04%) — watch for further semiconductor-led weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA near near-term resistance zones as RECOVERY needs follow-through (NVDA (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY); AAPL (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND to hold recent gains; JPM (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.32%) ABOVE TREND to confirm financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+75): JNJ (1W: +3.71% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. META (+55): META (1W: +7.07% | 1M: +1.80%) ABOVE TREND — news and price aligned. GOOGL (+60): GOOGL (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY — positive headlines support short-term bounce but 1M still negative.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
FCX (-50): FCX (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -9.26%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and weakness persistent. PSX (-45): PSX (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines diverge from strong price action, flag as a sentiment/price divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; Value/Cyclical style favored given Energy and Financials leadership. SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%) show relative strength. Key risk: major semiconductor divergences (INTC CORRECTION (1W: -21.05% | 1M: +11.16%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -21.09% | 1M: +25.94%)) and mixed Tech sentiment that could stall a durable risk-on move — monitor for confirmation.
